# dagsterplus_organization (Data Source)

Reads metadata about the Dagster+ organization configured in the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_organization" "current" {}

output "org_name" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_organization.current.name
}

output "org_status" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_organization.current.status
}

output "github_account" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_organization.current.github_account_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_review` (String) Account review status of the organization.
- `github_account_name` (String) GitHub account or organization name of the active GitHub App installation. Empty when not installed.
- `github_app_id` (String) GitHub App ID of the active installation. Empty when not installed.
- `github_repos` (List of String) Repositories accessible via the GitHub App installation.
- `github_settings_url` (String, Sensitive) URL to GitHub App installation settings. Empty when not installed.
- `id` (String) Organization name (used as the data source identifier).
- `name` (String) The organization name.
- `public_id` (String) The organization's public UUID.
- `slack_team_id` (String) Slack workspace team ID of the active Slack App installation. Empty when not installed.
- `slack_team_name` (String) Slack workspace name of the active Slack App installation. Empty when not installed.
- `status` (String) The organization status: `ACTIVE`, `READ_ONLY`, `SUSPENDED`, or `PENDING_DELETION`.
